reviewType: Independent integrated read-only source and executable review
conclusion: No remaining release-blocking runtime, API, resource, documentation, or package finding was identified against the exact frozen source. Finite review is not standards certification.
sourceFingerprintManifestFormat: UTF-8 JSON of sourceSha256 sorted by key, indent=2, with a final newline

coverage: JSON malformed escapes, surrogates, depth and non-finite values
GS1 text and URL malformed inputs
render matrix, geometry and resource limits
owned result snapshots and Send + Sync compilation
text/raw Structured Append round trips and parity
oversized arithmetic estimates without bit materialization
independentDirectApiProbes.interpretation: Counted probe operations/assertions, not 132250 independent randomly generated inputs.

kanjiRepertoire.comparison: Exact owner-JavaScript supported set and 13-bit values

resourceRegression.qualification: Single-process observed measurements in this environment, not a service latency guarantee.

detachedCargoPackage.qualification: Verified an exported source archive and an extracted, isolated consumer; adding final summary documents changes archive bytes but does not change the reviewed runtime fingerprint.

separateConformanceEvidence.qualification: The seven full conformance/decoder lanes were run by the separate conformance workflow; the reviewer independently checked that their source fingerprints match this frozen review.

findings.issue: Repeated UTF-16 prefix scans made valid many-element input quadratic.
findings.resolution: Use the validated ASCII-prefix offset invariant; successful parsing now has linear measured scaling.

findings.area: src/gs1.rs hostname mapping and ACE validation
findings.issue: Some decomposed/compatibility/format Unicode hosts serialized to ACE URLs rejected by browsers.
findings.resolution: Pinned Unicode 15.0.0 conservative rejection/lowercase/bidi data and ACE validation reject unsupported labels; supported outputs pass browser-stability probes.

findings.issue: Non-UTF-8 Unix arguments panicked through env::args.
findings.resolution: Fallible args_os conversion produces INVALID_INPUT and exit 1.

findings.issue: A global help scan intercepted literal --help values passed through --text or --.
findings.resolution: Parse help only as an option; explicit literal values encode correctly.

findings.issue: Packaged README linked to root security/contributing files omitted from the include list.
findings.resolution: Include referenced documents and Unicode license; detached archive inventory checked.

findings.issue: Documentation named a nonexistent generic append helper, wrong unknown-query policies, and imprecise one-symbol Structured Append behavior.
findings.resolution: Document actual GTIN/SSCC append helpers, preserve/reject policies, and ascending-version eligibility/skip behavior.

limits: Executed independently on Linux x86_64 only. macOS, Windows, remote CI and public-clone checks are separate publication gates, not claimed here.
Miri, sanitizers, 32-bit runtime execution and scanner hardware/print tests were not independently run.
No ISO/GS1 certification or complete WHATWG/UTS #46 acceptance equivalence is claimed; Unicode host support is deliberately conservative.
Finite malformed-input/property probes do not establish behavior under arbitrary simultaneous load, out-of-memory conditions, or every possible payload.
The reviewer did not push, publish, tag, merge or upload a release.
